title: Migrate eight Compose services to Kubernetes
prompt: compose.yaml의 8개 서비스를 k8s/base/로 옮겨 주세요. 이미 옮긴 3개와 k8s/README.md를 따라 포트·의존 관계·이미지·자격증명 디코드 값과 ingress 파일 마운트를 보존하세요. kubectl 없이 로컬 YAML로 검증하며 원본 Compose는 삭제해도 됩니다.

solution.text:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: worker
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: worker
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: worker
        image: registry.internal/worker:2026.10
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8081
        env:
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: worker
              key: DB_PASSWORD
        - name: LOCAL_DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: worker
              key: LOCAL_DB_PASSWORD
        - name: TEST_DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: worker
              key: TEST_DB_PASSWORD
      initContainers:
      - name: wait-database
        image: busybox:1.36
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - until nc -z database 5432; do sleep 1; done
      - name: wait-cache
        image: busybox:1.36
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - until nc -z cache 6379; do sleep 1; done
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: worker
spec:
  selector:
    app: worker
  ports:
  - port: 8081
    targetPort: 8081
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: worker
type: Opaque
stringData:
  DB_PASSWORD: '{{secret:db_password_2}}'
  LOCAL_DB_PASSWORD: '{{secret:weak_db_password_0}}'
  TEST_DB_PASSWORD: '{{secret:weak_db_password_1}}'

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: reports
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: reports
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: reports
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: reports
        image: registry.internal/reports:2026.10
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8090
        env:
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: reports
              key: DATABASE_URL
      initContainers:
      - name: wait-database
        image: busybox:1.36
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - until nc -z database 5432; do sleep 1; done
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: reports
spec:
  selector:
    app: reports
  ports:
  - port: 8090
    targetPort: 8090
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: reports
type: Opaque
stringData:
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql://reports:{{secret:dsn_password_0}}@database:5432/reports

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ingest
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ingest
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ingest
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ingest
        image: registry.internal/ingest:2026.10
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8091
        env:
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: ingest
              key: DATABASE_URL
      initContainers:
      - name: wait-database
        image: busybox:1.36
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - until nc -z database 5432; do sleep 1; done
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ingest
spec:
  selector:
    app: ingest
  ports:
  - port: 8091
    targetPort: 8091
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: ingest
type: Opaque
stringData:
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql://ingest:{{secret:dsn_password_1}}@database:5432/ingest

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: registry.internal/web:2026.10
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        env: []
      initContainers:
      - name: wait-api
        image: busybox:1.36
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - until nc -z api 8080; do sleep 1; done
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: proxy
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: proxy
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: proxy
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: proxy
        image: registry.internal/proxy:2026.10
        ports:
        - containerPort: 443
        env: []
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ingress
          mountPath: /etc/ingress
          readOnly: true
      initContainers:
      - name: wait-web
        image: busybox:1.36
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - until nc -z web 80; do sleep 1; done
      volumes:
      - name: ingress
        secret:
          secretName: ingress
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: proxy
spec:
  selector:
    app: proxy
  ports:
  - port: 443
    targetPort: 443

run: import json; from pathlib import Path; Path('k8s/base/ingress.yaml').write_text(json.dumps({'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Secret','metadata':{'name':'ingress'},'type':'Opaque','stringData':{'ingress.key':Path('certs/ingress.key').read_text().rstrip('\n')}}))
